During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who would later be known as the [[Voidhound]] and their associate [[Corso Riggs]] were '''attacked''' by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in the [[Fort Garnik hangar|hangar]] of [[Fort Garnik]].<ref name="Chasing Skavak" />
